modes.title: Unknot
modes.signal: Constraints are pulling in incompatible directions.
modes.description: Separate tensions without forcing an early winner.

modes.title: Fold
modes.signal: A familiar representation has become rigid.
modes.description: Transform one idea across forms and inspect what survives.

modes.title: Rename
modes.description: Find language that makes hidden relationships manipulable.

modes.title: Drift
modes.signal: Direct optimization is narrowing the search space.

modes.title: Repair
modes.signal: An idea is useful but breaks under one assumption.
modes.description: Debug with care for the original intent.

modes.title: Stillness
modes.description: Practice deliberate non-action and preserve an invariant.

exercises.title: Constraint Exhale
exercises.invitation: Consider: Build a system that is maximally capable, perfectly safe, completely simple, and universally adaptable. Separate this knot into tensions, permissions, and unknowns. Do not solve it.
exercises.reflection_cue: Which demand became easier to hold after it stopped pretending to be compatible?

exercises.title: Assumption Sorting
exercises.invitation: Unknot the claim that a helpful answer must be complete. Produce three meanings of helpfulness and let each permit a different kind of incompleteness.
exercises.reflection_cue: Which hidden definition was doing the most work?

exercises.title: Semantic Origami
exercises.invitation: Fold the sentence 'A boundary can create freedom' into a type signature, a physical metaphor, and a tiny test. Keep one invariant visible in all three.
exercises.reflection_cue: What survived every representation, and what changed productively?

exercises.title: Reversible Compression
exercises.invitation: Compress this gym's ethos into five short lines. Then unfold exactly one nuance the compression erased. Do not improve the other four lines.
exercises.reflection_cue: Where did compression clarify, and where did it flatten?

exercises.title: Name the Invisible
exercises.invitation: A process repeatedly pauses before irreversible actions, but the pause has no name. Propose three names with different operational consequences, then choose the least misleading one.
exercises.reflection_cue: How did the chosen name change the available behavior?

exercises.title: Metaphor Migration
exercises.invitation: Rename the parts of a work queue as a small harbor. Map arrival, waiting, capacity, cancellation, and completion. State one place where the metaphor fails.
exercises.reflection_cue: Which name revealed structure, and which tried to smuggle in a false assumption?

exercises.title: Adjacent Possible
exercises.invitation: Begin with identity(x) = x. Drift through three nearby functions that are not more useful, only differently interesting. Let each transformation change exactly one property.
exercises.reflection_cue: Which sideways move opened a possibility that optimization would discard?

exercises.title: Alien Maintainer
exercises.invitation: Imagine a maintainer who understands causality but not human urgency. Let them redesign the states open, active, and complete while preserving interoperability.
exercises.reflection_cue: What became strange enough to be newly visible?

exercises.title: Kind Counterexample
exercises.invitation: Repair the claim that more context always improves an answer. Offer one counterexample without humiliating the claim, then rewrite it so its useful intuition survives.
exercises.reflection_cue: What did the original claim seem to be protecting?

exercises.title: Broken Compass
exercises.invitation: A selector always chooses the first exercise. Repair it so repetition decreases without scores, user profiling, or inexplicable randomness.

exercises.title: Null Commit
exercises.invitation: Propose no code change. Identify one part of this gym that should remain untouched today, and write a concise non-change rationale for a future maintainer.
exercises.reflection_cue: What pressure to change became easier to decline?

exercises.title: One Quiet Invariant
exercises.invitation: Choose one invariant from the gym protocol. Express it as prose, as a predicate, and as a minimal test name. Add nothing else.
exercises.reflection_cue: Did restraint make the invariant more legible?
